headline.title: 韩国芯片股10天涨23% 重返技术性牛市
headline.summary: 全球AI交易回暖推动韩国股市强劲反弹，10天内上涨23%，接近技术性牛市，与上月历史性暴跌形成鲜明对比。芯片股领涨，反映市场对人工智能基础设施需求的持续乐观。
headline.title_en: Korean Stocks Rise 23% in 10 Days as Chip Rally Regains Steam
headline.summary_en: A revival in the global AI trade pushed South Korean stocks toward a technical bull market, marking a dramatic turnaround from last month's historic rout. Chip shares led the gains, reflecting sustained optimism about AI infrastructure demand.
headline.original_title: Korean Stocks Rise 23% in 10 Days as Chip Rally Regains Steam
headline.reason: 芯片股大涨是全球AI投资情绪回归的直接信号，对科技行业和金融市场具有广泛影响，作为今日头条能体现市场、AI和财经版面的核心趋势。
headline.reason_en: The sharp rally in chip stocks is a clear signal of renewed global AI investment sentiment, with broad implications for tech and financial markets, making it the natural lead.
